entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh right, today's Valentine's Day.[n]No wonder there were so many guys[n]bringing girls in here.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Don't you have anything exciting[n]happening? I mean, you've been here[n]nearly a whole year.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Y'know, when I was young, hoo boy...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Good evening...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...Sorry. Are you busy?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Ohhh... You should've just told me.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Here, I'll leave the store to you.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Enjoy yourselves...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I looove people who can read the[n]situation.
Have a seat.[clr 27]
I'll make you some coffee.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...Thanks.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: So you go to the reformatory without[n]telling me? And then you don't call me[n]after you get discharged?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: You really do things your own way, huh?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: You at least know why I came to see you[n]today, right?
Valentine's?
Some bad news?
I don't have any new stories.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Good answer.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Nooo. The opposite, if anything.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Whoa, you ARE the news.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Here...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: It's a limited edition that was really[n]expensive. I had to wait in a long line[n]for it, you know.
Thanks.[clr 27]
This is amazing.[clr 27]
What is it?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Don't eat it all, okay? I wanna have[n]some too.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Chocolate... and my love and stuff.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...So apparently, visiting hours are only[n]allowed for people at the fiancée level.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: So if you hadn't been released, then I[n]would've had to keep that gift for myself.
Were you worried?
Work still rough?
I've missed you.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...Well, I guess you could say that.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Yeah, but not so bad that I have to stay[n]to pull all-nighters.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I've missed you too...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...My publisher was going to reassign me[n]to the political department.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: They said it was because I did such[n]a good job contributing to the sales[n]numbers...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I'm gonna return the favor one of[n]these days, all right?
I should tell Ohya that I'm going home...
I'll be returning to my hometown.
I'm going home.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I see...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Can I sit next to you?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Maybe it's because you started working,[n]but you seem really mature now.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: You're going home next month, right?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: What should I do?
What do YOU want to do?
Want to tag along?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Seriously...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Huh?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...Oh, I am totally pressuring you—[n]Sorry about that.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Well, after all that's happened, I'm[n]used to waiting. And... you are still[n]in high school.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...But it's kind of annoying to be at[n]someone's beck and call, you know?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I'm gonna make sure that you never[n]forget about me...
I spent a romantic evening[n]with Ohya...
